lines.en: Hello. Are these apples sweet?
Yes, Ma'am. They came from the farm this morning.
lines.ko: 네, 손님. 오늘 아침에 농장에서 왔어요.

lines.en: I will take five apples and two pears.
lines.ko: 사과 다섯 개와 배 두 개 살게요.

lines.en: Do you want some grapes too?
How much are the grapes?
They are cheap today. One thousand a bag.
Good. Last week the price was high.
The peaches are sweet too. Please try one.
Wow, it's sweet. I will take two peaches.
lines.ko: 와, 달아요. 복숭아 두 개 살게요.

lines.en: Thank you, Ma'am. Here is your bag.
Which fruit do you like, apples or bananas?
lines.ko: 사과랑 바나나 중에 어떤 과일이 좋아요?

lines.en: I like bananas. They are soft and sweet.
Lemons are sour. Do you like them?
No, Grandma. Lemons are too sour for me.
lines.ko: 아니요, 할머니. 레몬은 저한테 너무 셔요.

lines.en: When I was young, I loved strawberries.
lines.ko: 제가 어렸을 때는 딸기를 정말 좋아했어요.

lines.en: Are strawberries sweet or sour?
They are sweet. We will buy some tomorrow.
Can we get oranges too, Grandma?
Sure. Oranges have a lot of juice.
Thanks, Grandma. Fruit is the best food.
